entries.claim: FirstRand Limited is listed on the JSE under ticker FSR; FNB is its retail/business banking division.
entries.source_ref: JSE listing / FirstRand annual results booklet

entries.claim: FNB Banking App is delivered as a hybrid React Native + webview build (publicly reported).
entries.source_ref: Public technology reporting; app-store metadata for FNB Banking App

entries.claim: Core banking is Hogan CBS fronted by in-house middleware with a Kafka event bus.
entries.source_ref: Company/technology reporting on FNB core and middleware

entries.claim: eBucks Rewards is a five-reward-level behavioural programme driven by product adoption, card usage, app logins and auto-sweep.
eBucks merchant partners include Checkers, Engen and iStore, with discounts advertised up to about 40% on selected categories.
FNB Connect is an MVNO operated under the FNB brand.
entries.source_ref: FNB Connect public app-store listing and marketing

entries.claim: Retail account ladder: Easy, Aspire, Premier, Private Clients/Wealth, Gold Business.
Group ROE above about 19% with a cost-to-income ratio around 51-53%.
entries.source_ref: FirstRand annual results (fiscal year ends 30 June)

entries.claim: The exact eBucks behaviour-to-level weighting formula is not public and remains unresolved.
entries.source_ref: pending REA extraction (mitmproxy + Frida hook on level computation)

entries.claim: FNB participates in BankservAfrica rails; PayShap scheme launched March 2023.
